Presbyopia Agents 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-560214  
Guideline Name 
Presbyopia Agents  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Qlosi, Vizz, Brand Vuity, generic pilocarpine 1.25% ophth soln, Yuvezzi  
Approval Length 
1 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of presbyopia  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 1362 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1362 
 
2 - History of failure or intolerance to a preferred* generic pilocarpine ophthalmic preparation  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Ophthalmologist  
• 
Optometrist  
 
AND 
 
4 - Provider confirms valid clinical rationale, which excludes lifestyle choice, as to why patient 
is unable to use corrective lenses (e.g., eyeglasses or contact lenses)  
Notes  
*PDL link: https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/health-plans-by-state/arizo
na-health-plans/az-comm-plan-home/az-cp-pharmacy.html?rfid=UHC
CP 
 
Product Name:Qlosi, Vizz, Brand Vuity, generic pilocarpine 1.25% ophth soln, Yuvezzi  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., improvement in near 
vision in low light conditions without loss of distance vision)  
 
AND 
 
2 - History of failure or intolerance to a preferred* generic pilocarpine ophthalmic preparation  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:
